text_block_list.text: One day, while watching training――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek……! I'm sorry, I'm so sorry…… I'm so 
sorry for taking up space without even 
running……!

I hurriedly stopped her and cleared up the 
misunderstanding...

When asked why she was staring at the 
track, it turned out she had been watching 
TM Opera O run.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to use it as an example, 
...but it seems too difficult for someone 
like me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So full of confidence, running with such 
raw power... Everything that I don't 
have...
choice_data_list:
Let's learn from that unwavering 
confidence first.

Let's take a page from that vitality 
first.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Confidence... That is precisely what I 
lack most right now.
choice_data_list: Dressing the part is one way to start.
Dressing the part is one way to start.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Starting with the persona... Do you mean 
coming up with a title, like Opera O does?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... taking after "End of the Century 
Overlord," maybe "End of the Century 
Surge"...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see, that's a wonderful name!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eh... O-Opera O-san...!? No way... Did you 
hear what I just...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-Please forget that...! That name was far 
too grand for someone like me...!

Running with true "raging torrent" 
momentum, Meisho Doto blows past a whole 
group of runners in the middle of 
training.
choice_data_list:
So this is... the "Raging Surge of the Fin 
de Siècle"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A name that truly defines the person! 
Hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-san's vibrant, radiant charm is 
truly captivating, no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're asking whether I can do 
the same... Um... it seems really 
difficult...
choice_data_list: Let's have her demonstrate it herself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If there's an example to follow... maybe 
somehow... U-Um, I'll go ask...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ha... Ha-ha-ha... *cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And right here... strike a magnificent 
pose!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... With elegance... with 
grace...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh~... oooohhh...~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what an original pose...! I can't let 
myself be outdone!
